purpose: Final outcome-blind compilation step before Discovery Sprint 01 scientific outcomes are inspected. Converts each Discovery Card (D1-D6) into either an EXECUTABLE_DISCOVERY_SPEC (fully frozen parameters, ready to run) or DEFERRED (blocking condition unmet). All executable specs are frozen in this single pass so no card's design can be informed by another card's already-observed outcome -- at compile time zero cards in this sprint have been executed, so this constraint is satisfied by construction.

no_confirmatory_machinery_introduced.note: This manifest freezes discovery-card parameters only. It carries none of the MARKET-06-style authority-chain machinery (permit/runner/sealed-RESULT); Discovery Card contract in HYPOTHESIS_DISCOVERY_PIPELINE_V2.json explicitly excludes that machinery from discovery.

D1.SPEC_STATUS_CORRECTED_BY: DISCOVERY_SPRINT_01_RED_TEAM_REVIEW (F5, F6); original SPEC_STATUS was EXECUTABLE_DISCOVERY_SPEC
D1.EXACT_UNIT_OF_OBSERVATION: One 24h decision point on the existing MARKET-06 24h decision grid (one observation every 24h, reusing ev.rv_btc_24h / ev.btc_ret_24h bar-end semantics -- not a newly defined time scale).

EXACT_STATE_DEFINITION.state_construction_class: Single frozen 2-state discrete indicator (no clustering algorithm, no k selection): HIGH_VOL_STATE(t) = 1 if RV_20(t) > median(RV_20(t-250 .. t-1)) else LOW_VOL_STATE(t).
EXACT_STATE_DEFINITION.RV_20_definition: RV_20(t) = sum of the 20-trailing-day realized-volatility values as already computed by ev.rv_btc_24h at each of the 20 most recent complete decision points ending at or before t (no lookahead; reuses the existing frozen RV construction).
EXACT_STATE_DEFINITION.rolling_baseline: Trailing 250 completed RV_20 values immediately preceding t (t excluded), median taken with no interpolation tie-break beyond numpy default.
free_parameters_frozen_now: rolling median baseline length = 250 decision points
number of states = 2 (fixed, no k sweep)

D1.EXACT_SMALL_SEARCH_SURFACE: Exactly the one state-construction class above, at RV window=20 / baseline=250, 2 states fixed. No alternative window/baseline pairs and no alternative state count are run for the primary result.
D1.EXACT_TARGET_FUNCTIONAL: MEAN_STATE_RUN_LENGTH = (mean consecutive-day run length of HIGH_VOL_STATE + mean consecutive-day run length of LOW_VOL_STATE) / 2, computed once over the full discovery interval.

EXACT_SIMPLE_BASELINE_NULL.family: GARCH(1,1)-filtered circular block-bootstrap surrogate ("GARCH-filtered surrogate"), a standard surrogate-data-testing construction.
EXACT_SIMPLE_BASELINE_NULL.fit: Fit GARCH(1,1) with Student-t innovations (df estimated by MLE) to the discovery-interval 24h log-return series (ev.btc_ret_24h at each decision point). Extract standardized residuals.
EXACT_SIMPLE_BASELINE_NULL.surrogate_generation: For each replicate, circular block-bootstrap the standardized residuals with fixed block length = 20 decision points (matched to the RV_20 window, so the null does not trivially chop up the very window being tested), reinject through the fitted GARCH(1,1) conditional-variance recursion (same omega/alpha/beta, reinitialized at the empirical unconditional variance) to produce a full-length surrogate 24h-return path.
EXACT_SIMPLE_BASELINE_NULL.why_defensible: GARCH(1,1) preserves short-memory conditional heteroskedasticity (ordinary day-to-day volatility clustering, which is NOT the structure under test) while destroying longer-horizon persistence beyond GARCH(1,1)'s implied memory -- i.e. it destroys only the multi-week regime-persistence structure D1 is testing for, per the SURROGATE_NULL_REQUIREMENT in MARKET_NEXT_HYPOTHESIS_SELECTION.json.
EXACT_SIMPLE_BASELINE_NULL.acknowledged_limits: This is A defensible null under standard practice, not claimed to be the only one; it remains subject to review before execution and is not itself evidence.

D1.EXACT_TEMPORAL_BREAKDOWN: Report MEAN_STATE_RUN_LENGTH and its surrogate-percentile position separately for calendar years 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 (partial 2020 from 02-01), in addition to the pooled full-interval statistic.

PROMISING_PROTOTYPE_EVALUATION_FIELDS.practical_magnitude_threshold: Observed value exceeds the surrogate median by at least +1.5 days.
PROMISING_PROTOTYPE_EVALUATION_FIELDS.neighborhood_stability_check: Pre-declared (not free-choice) companion runs at block length 15 and block length 25 (fixed, both frozen now, not a sweep for selection) must place the observed statistic above at least the 90th percentile in both companion nulls.
PROMISING_PROTOTYPE_EVALUATION_FIELDS.temporal_consistency_check: Effect must not be driven by a single calendar year: at least 3 of the 5 year-buckets must individually exceed their own year-bucket surrogate 90th percentile.
PROMISING_PROTOTYPE_EVALUATION_FIELDS.artifact_check: Confirm RV_20/median construction uses only bar-end-available data at each t (no lookahead) and that GARCH fit uses the same discovery interval, not a different window.

red_team_correction_2026_09_21.F6_RV_20_formula_fix: RV_20_definition above ('sum of the 20-trailing-day realized-volatility values') is SUPERSEDED. Corrected: RV_20(t) := sqrt( sum_{i=0}^{19} [ev.rv_btc_24h(t-i)]^2 ) -- variance-level (L2) aggregation of the 20 trailing daily RV values, not a direct (L1) sum of already-square-rooted values. This changes the rolling_baseline (median of RV_20 values) and HIGH_VOL_STATE/LOW_VOL_STATE thresholding accordingly; no other part of EXACT_STATE_DEFINITION changes.

checks: return marginal skewness/kurtosis within surrogate [5th,95th] band

F3_null_granularity_fix.problem: EXACT_SIMPLE_BASELINE_CONTROL above ('reuses D1's GARCH(1,1) ... surrogate 24h forward paths') is MECHANICALLY BROKEN: D1's null generates exactly one scalar 24h return per day and cannot produce a 288x5m intraday path, which all three D3 functionals require.
F3_null_granularity_fix.corrected_null_family: 5m_RETURN_POOLED_CIRCULAR_BLOCK_BOOTSTRAP: pool every 5-minute log return in the discovery interval (from the same CORE_BTC_BINANCE_V0 5m bars used for the outcome window); for each surrogate day, circular block-bootstrap this pooled sequence with block length 12 bars (~1h), concatenated to 288 bars, cumulated from a fixed unit starting price. The 3 functionals are computed on each surrogate path.
F3_null_granularity_fix.what_it_preserves: Empirical 5m-return marginal distribution and short-range (<=1h, within-block) autocorrelation/clustering, since blocks are real observed sub-sequences.
F3_null_granularity_fix.what_it_destroys: Date-specific/conditioning structure and >1h cross-block dependency within the 24h span -- appropriate for D3's UNCONDITIONAL_DESIGN.
F3_null_granularity_fix.not_an_arbitrary_bridge: This is the standard nonparametric block-bootstrap applied at native (5m) frequency, not a model-based or interpolated bridge between D1's daily-scale endpoints.
F3_null_granularity_fix.companion_stability_checks: Pre-declared companion block lengths of 6 and 24 bars, frozen now (mirrors D1's own neighborhood-stability pattern).

issue_1_direction_vs_unconditional_FIXED.decision: Option C selected outcome-blind: remove direction alignment entirely; D3 redefined as genuinely unconditional, unsigned path morphology. ev.btc_side_from_ret is no longer used by D3.

issue_1_direction_vs_unconditional_FIXED.supersedes: EXACT_FUNCTIONAL_DEFINITIONS above (MAX_ADVERSE_EXCURSION_24h, TIME_TO_MAX_ADVERSE_EXCURSION, PATH_ASYMMETRY's original denominator MAX_FAVORABLE_EXCURSION_24h)

issue_2_time_of_day_confound_FIXED.problem: The F3 null (5m_RETURN_POOLED_CIRCULAR_BLOCK_BOOTSTRAP) pools blocks ignoring time-of-day. Every MARKET-06 decision point starts at the fixed UTC clock time 00:05:00Z, so bar-offset k corresponds to the identical UTC time-of-day on every observation -- TIME_TO_MAX_EXCURSION IS a UTC time-of-day statistic. Ordinary session-based intraday volatility seasonality would concentrate the real distribution at specific bar-offsets while a time-of-day-blind null smears it out: a near-certain confound, demonstrated structurally (outcome-blind), not shown to be irrelevant.
issue_2_time_of_day_confound_FIXED.corrected_null_family: 5m_RETURN_TIME_OF_DAY_STRATIFIED_BLOCK_BOOTSTRAP: partition the 288 bar-offsets into 24 fixed 1-hour slots of 12 consecutive bar-offsets (slot i = bar-offsets [12i, 12i+11]). For each surrogate day and each slot INDEPENDENTLY, draw the replacement 12-bar block, with replacement, only from the pool of real historical blocks at that SAME slot position across the discovery interval -- never mixing blocks across slots.
issue_2_time_of_day_confound_FIXED.preserves_now: Everything the original null preserved (5m-return marginal, short-range <=1h autocorrelation/clustering) PLUS the marginal UTC time-of-day volatility profile.
issue_2_time_of_day_confound_FIXED.still_destroys: Date-specific/conditioning structure and cross-slot (>1h) dependency -- unchanged intent.
issue_2_time_of_day_confound_FIXED.parameters_unchanged: block_length_bars=12, replicates=1000, seed D3_NULL_SURROGATE_SEED=20260921103, companion checks at block lengths 6 and 24 (288/6=48 and 288/24=12 slots, both exact), all now slot-stratified.
issue_2_time_of_day_confound_FIXED.supersedes: EXACT_SIMPLE_BASELINE_CONTROL / corrected_null_family in the F3 fix above (5m_RETURN_POOLED_CIRCULAR_BLOCK_BOOTSTRAP is superseded by the slot-stratified variant; same block length/replicates/seed)

EXACT_COMPONENTS.component_B: D2 RULE_2 (DISLOCATION_ABSTENTION) verbatim, unmodified, same threshold (z > 2.0).

D5.EXACT_COMPOSITION_OPERATOR: OR: COMPOSED_ABSTAIN(t) = 1 if component_A(t)=1 OR component_B(t)=1, else 0. AND-composition is explicitly NOT tested in this sprint (reserved for a possible future card, kept out of this frozen surface).
D5.EXACT_SMALL_SEARCH_SURFACE: Exactly one composition (OR) of exactly the two named components at their existing D2 parameterization. No combinatorial search over which components to combine, no parameter retuning.
D5.EXACT_TARGET_FUNCTIONAL: Reuses D2's exact DELTA definition (mean adverse_path_severity | ABSTAIN minus RATE_MATCHED_RANDOM_ABSTENTION control | ABSTAIN), applied to COMPOSED_ABSTAIN.

EXACT_SIMPLE_BASELINE_CONTROL.primary: RATE_MATCHED_RANDOM_ABSTENTION, reusing D2's exact construction methodology (year-matched random abstention at COMPOSED_ABSTAIN's realized rate), 1000 replicates.
EXACT_SIMPLE_BASELINE_CONTROL.beat_best_component: COMPOSED DELTA must exceed BOTH component_A's own DELTA (from D2) and component_B's own DELTA (from D2), not merely beat doing nothing.

PROMISING_PROTOTYPE_EVALUATION_FIELDS.statistical_threshold: COMPOSED DELTA exceeds the 95th percentile of its 1000-replicate RATE_MATCHED_RANDOM_ABSTENTION distribution.
PROMISING_PROTOTYPE_EVALUATION_FIELDS.beats_best_component_check: COMPOSED DELTA > max(component_A DELTA, component_B DELTA) from D2's own results.
PROMISING_PROTOTYPE_EVALUATION_FIELDS.multiple_testing_note: This is explicitly a THIRD look at the RV/dislocation observable family (after D2's two individual rules). Any eventual confirmatory proposal arising from D5 must account for that multiplicity across D2A/D2B/D5 jointly, not evaluate D5 as an isolated first look.

D6.selection_basis: Chosen for being fully reconstructible from CORE_BTC_BINANCE_V0 price data alone (no new data acquisition), publicly documented with a stated formula (not a proprietary/ambiguous source), and materially different in construction and claim from MARKET-03. NOT chosen by comparing multiple external candidates' reproduction performance -- no reproduction has been run.
D6.EXACT_SOURCE_IDENTITY: "Pi Cycle Top Indicator": a publicly documented BTC technical indicator (111-day SMA crossing above 2x the 350-day SMA), originally popularized by Philip Swift / LookIntoBitcoin. No source-code repository or paper exists for this indicator; the citable version is the canonical public formula itself -- no proprietary variant, no alternate parameterization.
D6.EXTERNALLY_STATED_MECHANISM: A crossover of the 111-day simple moving average above 2x the 350-day simple moving average of BTC price has historically coincided closely (within days, per the source's public description) with local BTC price cycle tops in the 2013, 2017, and 2021 cycles.
D6.EXTERNALLY_STATED_TARGET: Calendar-day proximity between a crossover-signal date and the subsequent realized local BTC price maximum (cycle top).
D6.EXTERNALLY_STATED_COMPARATOR: None formally published -- the original source presents this as a descriptive/visual historical coincidence, not a backtested strategy with a stated statistical baseline. This absence is recorded as an explicit LIMITATION, not silently filled in after the fact: Signalbot's reproduction supplies its own comparator (below), which is Signalbot's addition, not the external source's.
D6.EXACT_DATASET_AUTHORITY: CORE_BTC_BINANCE_V0, snapshot_id 717d37a404f81eefd58c9a796cc11868c48226baf1de8ffecad5e5607f8dd415, daily closes derived from the existing 1m archive.
D6.EXACT_HISTORICAL_DISCOVERY_INTERVAL: Full CORE_BTC_BINANCE_V0 history available before 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z (i.e. 2020-01-01T00:00:00Z -> 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z, hard-capped to keep protected 2025/2026 unopened). Known limitation: the source's originally-cited 2013 and 2017 coincidences predate this dataset's coverage and cannot be reproduced here; only whatever 111/350-day crossovers occur within 2020-2025 (expected to include at most the 2021 cycle top region) are reproducible. This partiality is reported as a limitation, not concealed.
D6.EXACT_UNIT_OF_OBSERVATION: One daily close per calendar day.
D6.EXACT_SMALL_SEARCH_SURFACE: Reproduction of the externally specified 111-day / 2x350-day SMA crossover only; no internal parameter variant search (no alternate SMA lengths, no alternate multiplier).
D6.SIGNALBOT_SUPPLIED_COMPARATOR: Naive baseline: proximity (in calendar days) between the nearest local BTC price maximum and a randomly chosen date within a fixed +/-180-day window, repeated 1000 times per crossover event with a fixed seed, to give an empirical null for 'how close is a local max to an arbitrary nearby date' against which the crossover-to-top proximity is compared.
D6.EXACT_TEMPORAL_BREAKDOWN: Reported per individual crossover event found in-window (expected to be a small number of discrete events, not a year-by-year continuous series), each with its own proximity-to-comparator comparison.

PROMISING_PROTOTYPE_EVALUATION_FIELDS.reproduction_threshold: Observed crossover-to-top proximity is closer (fewer calendar days) than at least 95% of the 1000 random-date replicates, for the in-window crossover event(s).
PROMISING_PROTOTYPE_EVALUATION_FIELDS.diagnostic_use_only: A PROMISING or reproduced result here calibrates confidence in the discovery pipeline's own baseline/search-surface/prototype-gate design; it is NOT recorded as an internal discovery success and does NOT add an internal edge candidate.

F7_usefulness_decision.problem: CORE_BTC_BINANCE_V0 begins 2020-01-01; the source's own cited coincidences are 2013, 2017, 2021. At most ONE testable episode (2021) falls inside available (pre-2025-01-01) data.
F7_usefulness_decision.assessment: A benchmark resting on a single instance has essentially no statistical calibration power (a hit does not rule out a high false-positive rate; a miss does not establish over-conservatism at N=1) -- the same standard the Promising Prototype Gate applies elsewhere (disqualifying one-isolated-instance results) applied to this diagnostic card itself.
F7_usefulness_decision.decision: DEFER D6. A replacement external benchmark, testable with materially more than one episode inside 2020-2025 and selected without any Signalbot outcome inspection, is required before an external-benchmark card can be executed in this sprint. Selecting that replacement is out of scope for this review.
